info.name: Return the data for all Activities

params.name: activity_description_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single ActivityDescription. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Activity. The list will be filtered to include only the Activity records with the matching property.

params.name: calendar_entry_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single CalendarEntry. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Activity. The list will be filtered to include only the Activity records with the matching property.

params.name: communication_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Communication. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Activity. The list will be filtered to include only the Activity records with the matching property.

params.name: contact_note_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Note. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Activity. The list will be filtered to include only the Activity records with the matching property.

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter Activity records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: end_date
params.description: Filter Activity records to those whose `date` is on or before the date provided (Expects an ISO-8601 date).

params.name: expense_category_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single ExpenseCategory. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Activity. The list will be filtered to include only the Activity records with the matching property.

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: flat_rate
params.description: Filter Activity TimeEntry records to those that have a flat rate, or not.

params.name: grant_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Grant. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Activity. The list will be filtered to include only the Activity records with the matching property.

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter Activity records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of Activity records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Matter. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Activity. The list will be filtered to include only the Activity records with the matching property.

params.name: matter_note_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Note. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Activity. The list will be filtered to include only the Activity records with the matching property.

params.name: only_unaccounted_for
params.description: Only unaccounted for activities.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the Activity records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: query
params.description: Wildcard search for `note` matching a given string.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Filter Activity records to those whose `date` is on or after the date provided (Expects an ISO-8601 date).

params.name: status
params.description: Filter Activity records to those that are draft, billed, unbilled or non-billable.

params.name: task_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Task. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Activity. The list will be filtered to include only the Activity records with the matching property.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter Activity records to those of a specific type.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter Activity records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: user_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single User. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Activity. The list will be filtered to include only the Activity records with the matching property.
